intro: Rough Wolf Pelts is an introductory skinning quest in Elwynn Forest offered by Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire. With her husband away assisting near Northshire Abbey, Helene relies on capable skinners to harvest raw hides from local wolves to complete her pending leatherworking orders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
